comment: The Haro v0.10 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.10 grows v0.9 by what the WORLD row of the charter's section 3 needs -- 'the ontology declared beside the grammar, as versioned data (C1, world.json)' -- and nothing else: a SYMBOL kind, a seat type whose value is a name resolved against a C1 world when the court is handed one (KIND: the symbol kind it resolves to; REF: the kind of ref the sentence contributes for it; MESSAGE: the refusal when the world declares no such symbol), and PUBLISH on the WORLD -- which DECLARATION kinds a sentence contributes as symbols, and as which symbol kind. The court's `check <file> [world.json]` resolves every SYMBOL seat when a world is given and says NO_WORLD, a warning, when none is; `world <file>` emits the sentence's own C1 rows. Every v0.9 fixture still passes: v0.10 refuses nothing v0.9 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a SYMBOL: a seat type resolved against the world -- its KIND, the REF it contributes, its MESSAGE
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow", REF "calls", MESSAGE "step {name} invokes '{value}', and the world declares no flow:{value}") RATIONALE "a ZQL flow, declared in the world and never here"
DEFINE DECLARATION invocation AS (VERB "INVOCATION", SEATS [invokes: flow, compensated_by: flow?]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: PUBLISH on the WORLD: which kinds a sentence contributes as symbols, and as which symbol kind
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION entity AS (VERB "ENTITY", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD z AS (PUBLISH [flow: flow, entity: entity]) RATIONALE "a world declares its flows and entities for every court that cites them"

accepts.name: a v0.9 declaration is a v0.10 declaration: v0.9's A2, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION aexpr AS (OPERATORS [add], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [compute], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], COMPUTE [compute, into, value]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a SYMBOL has a KIND
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (REF "calls") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: PUBLISH names DECLARATIONs of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD z AS (PUBLISH [river: flow]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a SYMBOL types a scalar seat, never a list's element
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION batch AS (VERB "BATCH", SEATS [invokes: [flow]]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a list seat's element must be a declared FORM, DECLARATION, MENU or a UNION of declarations

rejects.name: two SYMBOLs do not resolve to the same KIND: one name, one meaning
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL transaction AS (KIND "flow") RATIONALE "x"
